title: 穷人的智能体建模：在笔记本电脑上模拟大型LLM智能体社会
summary: 提出用低参数模型替代LLM智能体，通过少量查询拟合，在笔记本上模拟大规模智能体社会。引入交互顺序×记忆分类法预测替代误差趋势，并在多个模拟中验证，成本仅几美元。
summary_en: Proposes replacing LLM agents with low-parameter models fitted from few queries to simulate large agent societies on a laptop. Introduces interaction-order×memory taxonomy to predict surrogate error trends, validated on multiple simulations at low cost.
